title: Obstructions to a smooth conformal crossover in Penrose's Conformal Cyclic Cosmology: electron mass at future infinity (RG-4) and an uncompensated anomaly pole for Hadamard gravitons (G-V3). Pre-registered working record, version 2

description:
Pre-registered working record of an independent research programme (LC-RACCORD) on the conformal matching between aeons in Penrose's Conformal Cyclic Cosmology. Nothing here is claimed as established; the purpose of the deposit is priority and external review.

Two results are put forward for scrutiny. (1) RG-4: on a regular conformal boundary at future infinity, the electron mass is an obstruction to the smooth crossover unless a mass-erasure mechanism absent from the Standard Model is assumed; the spin-1/2 derivation extends Friedrich's Theorem 3.1 (arXiv:1311.0700) and is the point most in need of an outside reader. (2) G-V3: on de Sitter, for conformal fields in any Hadamard state and a gravitational wave with non-zero electric Weyl data, the local Wess-Zumino term of the conformal-anomaly action produces in Friedrich's regularity equation a pole (8bκ/Ω)W_E that nothing in the class "integrable anomaly action + one-loop effective action in a Hadamard state" compensates; the resummation Ω^(−8bκH²) is a procedure, not a theorem.

Also included: a single condition (m_h² = 2H²) making the Higgs and all Yukawa masses regular at the boundary, at the cost of a sign change and 87 orders of magnitude in the Higgs mass parameter; the acyclic fallback, under which the electron is no obstruction at the Big Bang; a costed phase-0 HPC proposal for the 3D generic BKL spike-additivity test.

Version 1 (23 September 2026) is included unchanged. All pieces were produced in conversation with an AI assistant under a sealed pre-registration protocol (hypotheses, verdict space and anti-fit prediction fixed before any calculation), audited only by isolated AI auditors; no human third party has read them. Full working notes 89–164, seals, blind-audit prompts and reports, scripts and outputs: github.com/droppy94/LC_Raccord, commit bcce2d23. Two syntheses written for an outside reader (NOTE-163, NOTE-164) are in folder 05. Comments and refutations are welcome.

Résumé en français dans LISEZMOI.md.
